newsitem.title: USA: Continental Can sees Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Continental Can sees Q4 loss.

text.p: Continental Can Co Inc said on Tuesday it expects to record a fourth-quarter loss at the company and its subsidiary, Plastic Containers Inc, or PCI.
The loss is a result of the company's tender offer to buy a larger stake in PCI from Merrywood Inc as well as two PCI plant closings, in Ohio and New Jersey.
The company said it is still determining the total costs associated with these closings but expects them to exceed $5 million of which about $1.5 million has been accrued.

"Both the increase in our ownership of PCI and the operating improvements which will result from 1996 charges relating to plant closings, will be reflected in substantially improved profitably for Continental Can in 1997 and later years," the company said in a written statement.
